description: This file defines interfaces for warning reporting including warning events and control mechanisms within the WPEFramework namespace. It declares abstract classes for warning event handling and warning reporting control, facilitating serialization, categorization, and management of warning events.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning events, supporting serialization, category retrieval, string conversion, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, enabling warning event reporting and category management.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface for warning categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Exclude a specified category from reporting.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a copy of the warning reporting control object.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Report a warning event with a specific identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieve information about a specific warning category.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Add a category control to the list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Remove a category control from the list.
